caseName: Kramer v. Public Employment Relations Commission
caseNameFull: Kramer v. Public Employment Relations Commission
judges: Ante, Certiorari, Consideration, Grant, Hudson, Light, Remand, Vacate, Writ

opinions.text:
Sup. Ct. N. J. Certiorari denied.

Justice Blackmun would grant the petition for writ of certiorari, vacate the judgment, and remand the case for further consideration in light of Teachers v. Hudson, ante, p. 292.
